settings.title: Size & Confidence Guarantee
settings.content:
Not sure which size will sculpt your shape? Take our 15-second Fit Quiz right under the size picker for instant guidance.

  • Shapewear always looks small when you unpack it — that’s normal. It’s built to stretch, sculpt, and hug your curves.
  • Order your usual size for a snatched, sculpted effect. Prefer a little more comfort for all-day wear? Size up.

    And don’t stress: if it doesn’t make you feel confident, our Confidence Guarantee means you can exchange it free until it does.

settings.title: Shipping & Returns
settings.content:
Delivered to you in 4-6 working days, track & trace code included. Free shipping above €80.

We offer a 14 day return or exchange policy, no questions asked! Simply start your own return here.

settings.title: FAQ
settings.content:
How do I know which size to pick?
Shapewear sizing can feel tricky, we get it. Just use our 15-second Fit Quiz or check the Size Guide — we list real measurements, so you’ll know exactly what works for your shape. Still unsure? Exchanges are free until you find the perfect fit.

Will it roll down?
No. Our Seamless Snatched bodysuit is designed with a grip band and compression that actually stays in place. No awkward tugging, no rolling. Just smooth support that moves with you.

Can I wear it all day?
Yes! We made sure the fabric is breathable and soft so you can feel sculpted without feeling suffocated. Snatched enough for a night out, comfy enough for a full day.

How do I go to the bathroom in it?
We thought of that. The snap closure at the gusset makes bathroom breaks quick and easy. No need to take everything off.

Will it show under clothes?
Nope. The seamless design disappears under dresses, jeans, or even tight tops. It’s your invisible confidence booster.
